name: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 6

function.text: MAP3K6 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 6. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine kinase activity and MAP kinase kinase kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and JNK cascade.
